verdict.rationale: Medusa's commerce modules (Product, Order, Cart, Payment, Fulfillment, Tax, Inventory) and official Admin/Store OpenAPI specs demonstrate comprehensive programmatic control over products, orders, refunds, and fulfillments, backed by the official js-sdk verified to work at runtime. missing for 10: independent developer testimonials specifically confirming refund/fulfillment API workflows in production, and a working live OpenAPI/swagger endpoint (probe found 404s on hosted docs site, though the GitHub-hosted spec exists).
